messages.text: @Tim Smith created a swarm request from Omega Inc. in Service Cloud *- Closed * Case | Salesforce Case Link View Case button Reopen swarm button *Swarm Description:* Android device, reported that the app crashes whenever they attempt to access the 'Profile' section. They've already tried reinstalling the app, but the issue persists. This issue is impacting their ability to update personal information and settings within the app. When you are done collaborating, you can finish the Swarm and records will be updated in Salesforce.
Hey team, we've got a user reporting that our Android app crashes when trying to access the 'Profile' section. Reinstalling didn't solve the issue. Any ideas on how to troubleshoot?
Thanks for bringing this up. Let's gather more info. Could you ask the user for their device model, Android OS version, and our app version? Also, any specific error messages they've encountered?

Good point. I'll reach out to the user for those details. Meanwhile, any common issues related to the 'Profile' section we should be aware of? Are there any recent changes in the codebase that might be causing this?

Checking in here. I ran some tests on the latest build, and it seems there might be a bug in the Profile section. Have you made any recent changes to the Profile module? Let the user know we're actively investigating and appreciate their patience.

Thanks for the heads up! After reviewing recent changes, I found a bug in the Profile module affecting certain Android versions. I've fixed it, and we'll roll out a patch in the next update. Inform the user about the upcoming fix and apologize for the inconvenience. Let me know if there are any further issues.

Summary:
Customer Support reported an Android app crashing issue in the 'Profile' section, persisting after reinstalling. Android Developer and QA Engineer investigated, finding a bug related to recent code changes.
Fix highlights:
• The fix involves addressing a compatibility issue with certain Android versions and optimizing data retrieval in the Profile module.
• A patch will be included in the upcoming app update.
• Customer Support will notify the user, emphasizing appreciation for their patience during the resolution process.
